eligibility: First saved action decision in Phase::Play with more than one legal action per distinct regular turn; all post-roll turns, no opponent hidden-card requirement.
selection: For m eligible turns select n=min(16,m), indices floor(i*m/n), i=0,...,n-1, in chronological order; uses no predictions or outcomes.
weighting: One unit of total weight per game; each selected position receives 1/n_selected.
labels: Saved final win of the actor at the sampled decision; original greedy Gen37-versus-Gen37 continuation.
scope: 10,000 existing unique completed network controls; duplicated tested-seat controls verified then deduplicated.
excluded: Setup, pre-roll, chance, forced-only turns, and non-Play subdecisions.
training_target: Gen37 target is 35% actual outcome plus 65% search value, gamma=1; this measures empirical calibration under the saved greedy policy, not optimal-play probabilities.
uncertainty: Whole-game nonparametric bootstrap from per-game sufficient statistics; pointwise 95% percentile intervals.
